description: This Java class defines a singleton validator for message direction headers, ensuring values are either 'TO' or 'FROM'. It extends an abstract header validator and throws an exception if validation fails.

classes.name: DittoMessageDirectionValueValidator
classes.description: A singleton validator class that checks if a CharSequence is 'TO' or 'FROM', representing message direction.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the singleton instance of this validator.

methods.name: validateValue
methods.description: Validates the header value to ensure it matches allowed message directions ('TO' or 'FROM'); throws an exception if invalid.
